items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: Then he'd come and say, young man, you play a nice horn. He'd say, I'd like you to work with me. I said, thank you, Mr. Robichaux, I'm doing all right.

ctx.x: Then after, and I'd taken all Robichaux away, called the Yacht Club and the Country Club, up and down St. Charles Trees, the gymnasium. Then he'd come and say, young man, you play a nice horn. He'd say, I'd like you to work with me. I said, thank you, Mr. Robichaux, I'm doing all right. Called him Mr. Robichaux.
But was your band a reading band, or did you play by ear mostly?
